title: Steadfast Love and Faithfulness Have Met

request.style: English, female solo voice, piano, cello, acoustic guitar, soft strings, uplifting ballad, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Show us your steadfast love, O Lord
Grant us your salvation now
I will hear what God the Lord will speak
Peace to his people, his faithful ones

[Pre-Chorus]
Let them not turn back to folly
His salvation is near to those who fear him
That glory may dwell in our land

[Chorus]
Steadfast love and faithfulness have met
Righteousness and peace have kissed
Faithfulness springs up from the earth
Righteousness looks down from heaven

[Verse]
The Lord himself will give what is good
Our land will yield its increase
Righteousness goes before him
Makes a path for his steps

[Chorus]
Steadfast love and faithfulness have met
Righteousness and peace have kissed
Faithfulness springs up from the earth
Righteousness looks down from heaven

[Bridge]
Glory dwells in the land
Peace speaks to the faithful
Salvation is near
Steadfast love abides

[Chorus]
Steadfast love and faithfulness have met
Righteousness and peace have kissed
Faithfulness springs up from the earth
Righteousness looks down from heaven

[Outro]
Righteousness goes before him
And makes a path for his steps
